mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is at a historically low level (0.13% as of 2015-06-01), which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is above 5.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 237.0) signals an accommodative monetary policy that is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 237.0, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (defined by a decline in real GDP growth in the most recent quarter), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative due to heightened economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth rate is negative, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals strong economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 105.0, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is at 141,842 thousand (as of 2015-06-01), which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is above 140,000 thousand, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high residential sales (RSAFS) and high housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is above 440,000 and HOUST is above 1000, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in residential sales (RSAFS) above 440,000 signals strong consumer demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is above 440,000, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
